# nRF vendor SDK

This directory holds Nordic's vendor SDK (nrfx + MDK/CMSIS) as a git submodule, pinned to a
specific version. Add it with:

```
git submodule add https://github.com/NordicSemiconductor/nrfx.git mcu/nrf/vendor/nrfx
```

Not yet populated — the specific nRF family (nRF52, nRF53, nRF54, ...) has not been chosen.
